summary.content:
Today's selection covers 67 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 48 on Artificial Intelligence and 10 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Pentagon stops using Anthropic AI tools after blacklisting company, BBC told
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Sam Altman says ‘some bad things’ will happen, but AI is totally worth it
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 46 articles published in the last 24 hours
